messages:
alex: quick question — opened a PR to add a new microservice dir under /services/payments
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/feature/payments-dir
alex: It touches CODEOWNERS so CI is blocking merge until someone with ownership approves. Who is allowed to approve adding a new services/* entry? I thought eng-platform or eng-infra?
morgan: @alex generally: if it's just a new service skeleton and no infra changes, eng-platform can approve. If it changes infra configs (deploy / terraform / cloud infra), eng-infra needs to sign off.
morgan: can you paste the CODEOWNERS diff here? makes it quicker to decide
alex: here's the diff I'm proposing:
```
/services/payments/ @payments-team @eng-platform
```
alex: we're adding only code + README + basic routes, no terraform or k8s manifests in this PR.
tasha: if this actually integrates with an external payments processor / handles secrets we should loop in security. Otherwise eng-platform + payments-team is fine.
prashant: payments-team lead here — I can review and approve once CI passes. tagging me is fine.
ci-bot: Build passed — all checks green (link: https://ci.redwood/1234)
prashant: skimmed the diff, left one tiny nits comment about a log message. once that's fixed, I can approve.
alex: fixed the log message and pushed a new commit.
prashant: approved :white_check_mark:
morgan: merging on green. FYI @eng-platform — we added payments-team as codeowner for /services/payments/; if anyone wants a different pattern (e.g., teams per subdir) speak up before the next cleanup.
alex: thanks everyone! merging now :rocket:
